rationale: Price gapped up 17.8% and has been in a clear downtrend throughout the session — opening at $14.35, reaching a high of $14.62, and now trading at $13.79, sitting at only 22% of today's range with the last five candles showing consecutive lower highs and lower lows with accelerating volume on the down moves. The stock is trading below both VWAP ($14.13) and the 9-EMA ($14.11), confirming bearish intraday momentum, but the proximity to today's low ($13.56) and the wide ATR relative to the remaining range make a short entry here unfavorable risk/reward. A long against the trend is equally unattractive given the sustained selling pressure from the gap open.
